notes.title: 🛠️ Patch v1.0.3.2 – Crash Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hey Café Owners! This small patch targets several crash sources and stability edge cases.

🐞 Bug Fixes

 Warehouse save crash: Fixed an issue where the Warehouse inventory could contain a null reference, causing a crash when a save/autosave was triggered.
 Restocker travel crash: Fixed a rare crash when the Restocker tried to restock a shelf that was being unloaded during level travel; queues are now cleared or re-targeted safely.
 Repair Station autosave crash: Fixed a timing issue where removing a CPU from the Repair Station exactly as an autosave started could cause a null reference.
 Login line cleanup: Fixed a dangling reference in the login machine queue after sleep/wake cycles that could lead to a crash on the next assignment.


If you encounter anything else, drop a report on Discord or the Steam Community—thanks for helping keep the café running smoothly! ☕🎮

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978540/Gaming_Cafe_Simulator/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186465/86d090a06a8489b2dbbb72c24bc37f91207f34c1.png

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch v1.0.3.1 – Crash Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hey Café Owners!
Today’s small patch targets two rare but nasty crashes affecting the Restocker and customer AI.

🐞 Bug Fixes

 Resolved an issue where, if the Restocker couldn’t reach a specific shelf, it added extra items to the next shelf’s queue, eventually throwing a nullptr and crashing the game.
 Fixed a very rare logic error where a customer, after finishing an action, looked for a non-existent interactable, resulting in a crash.


We’ll keep polishing to ensure a smooth, stable experience. Thanks for your continued feedback and support! 🎮🧹

notes.title: 🛠️🎮 Full Release 1.0 : New Workers, Ultimate PCs, Store Parts & Customization!
notes.content:
Hey Café Owners!

We’re officially out of Early Access! This milestone update brings new features, systems, and quality-of-life improvements to take your café to the next level. Here's everything new:

👨‍🔧 New Workers

 Restocker – Refills shelves using a filter list and item rate preferences.
 PC Repair Technician – Manages broken PCs and keeps your rigs running smoothly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186465/c806b8123e8343557576faaebecfc9bef7f7bc61.gif

🛒 Store Expansion & PC Parts

 Expanded the store layout with 2 new shelf types.
 Added PC parts (CPU, RAM, GPU, CPU Cooler, etc.) for buying, selling, and repairs.
 Balanced item pricing and base cost across the store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186465/507a9326cfdc0f6801a995e2452a5765336f300f.gif

💻 New Ultimate PCs

 Introduced 2 powerful Ultimate PCs.
 Each comes with its own repairable components.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186465/c152fa79b647082f793b85c1f5ae9c03f8dc5da9.gif

🎨 Café Customization

 Added Paint Roller Tool to recolor walls with various paints.
 New decorations including lights, plants, and A–Z alphabet wall panels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186465/7409eea4b7ef3d6b308114fdd7371c58064ec19e.gif

💰 Item Rate Change

 You can now customize the pricing of the items you sell from shelves.
 Adjust rates to maximize profits or run discounts to attract more customers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186465/48f4c814ee5fdce3d6955001f953a914aef13f97.png

🛠️ Shelf Filter System

 Control what items the Restocker will refill based on your selected filter list.


📊 Updated MainMenu

 The MainMenu Map now shows progress from your last saved file in the Building.


🏆 New Achievements

 Added 2 new achievements related to Store and Arcade upgrades.
 Updated the “Hire All Workers” achievement to include new hires.


⚙️ New Settings

 Added X and Y Axis Invert options in General Settings.
 Added Keyboard Type toggle for QWERTY and AZERTY in General Settings.


🐞 Bug Fixes

 Fixed customers spawning on walls, which caused crashes.
 Fixed Driving Sim idle animation not playing after loading a save.
 Fixed food not being destroyed when sleeping with cafeteria customers present.
 Fixed CPU pickup issue on Repairing Table.
 Fixed wall overlapping issues in some café expansions.
 Fixed VR Display not turning off when the Setup is damaged.


🚀 Improvements

 Added spark particle and sound effect when a PC gets damaged.
 Added “ting” sound when the main door opens.
 Randomizer was added for customers when they selected Shelve or Vending Machine.
 Update PC Rent Calculation for Game Balancing.
 Updated PC and Console parts' damage probability and damage rate.
 Updated and fixed localization for smoother gameplay in all supported languages.
 Visual and UI improvements across menus and interfaces.
 Stability and performance optimizations to ensure a smoother experience.


🔮 What’s Next?
Releasing the game doesn’t mean we’re done! We will continue adding new features, fixing bugs, and improving your café experience.

Thank you for your continued support, feedback, and enthusiasm. We couldn’t have made it this far without our amazing community. Here’s to many more updates ahead! 💖🎮
Share feedback and suggestions on our Discord or Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978540/Gaming_Cafe_Simulator/
